brief:
Calgary Opera cancelled future performances by a Canadian opera singer after he raised a Palestinian flag on stage, the company confirmed. The decision follows the singer's actions during a recent production at the venue.

The removal marks a escalating row over pro-Palestinian activism in cultural institutions. Calgary Opera did not immediately clarify whether the singer's actions violated venue policies or constituted a political statement the organization sought to distance itself from, according to Al Jazeera English.
dek: Calgary’s opera house has removed a singer from future performances after he raised a Palestinian flag on stage.
title: Calgary opera house removes singer who raised Palestinian flag
